data.executive_summary: This report analyzes crop yield predictions using area and production data across seasons. The model achieved an R² score of 0.9882 but shows consistent underprediction bias (mean residual +50.16) in three crop categories: Nutri/Coarse Cereals, Small Millets, and Shree Anna/Nutri Cereals.
data.methodology: Used Random Forest Regressor with features including crop type dummies (21 categories), seasonal indicators, and area/production metrics. Evaluated using MAE (66.37), RMSE (114.64), and R² (0.9882).
data.results_analysis: Model predictions (n=58) show mean yield of 1,773.64 with range 507.89-4,632.77. Visualizations reveal systematic underprediction patterns in three crop categories with 3.4% of predictions exceeding 3σ error thresholds. Key metrics: MAE=66.37, RMSE=114.64, R²=0.9882.
data.conclusions: The model successfully predicts crop yields with high accuracy (R²=0.9882) but exhibits consistent underprediction in three specialized cereal categories. This suggests either unique growth patterns or insufficient training data for these specific crop types.
data.recommendations:
1. Collect additional data for underrepresented crop categories
2. Consider specialized models for high-error crop types
3. Monitor prediction residuals for these categories in production
4. Investigate feature engineering for crop-specific variables
